decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's existing knowledge of coolant handling and machine tool peripherals, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product in-house.
A coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's coolant filtration and separation expertise, giving it the related knowledge to assimilate customer results and improve the design.
Coolant nozzles are a simple, closely related complement to the firm's coolant systems, carry low risk, and support bundled system sales.
A scraper belt chip conveyor is a core chip-handling product type where the firm already holds deep application and engineering knowledge.
A magnetic belt chip conveyor extends established conveyor know-how to fine ferrous chips, a closely related area the firm can learn from and improve.
A hinged belt chip conveyor is a standard product in the firm's chip conveyor line, sits squarely within its existing knowledge base, and rounds out the portfolio.
